newsitem.title: USA: Elizabeth Taylor to stay in hospital for day or two.
newsitem.headline: Elizabeth Taylor to stay in hospital for day or two.

text.p: Actress Elizabeth Taylor will remain hospitalized for another day or two following a brain seizure that put her back in the hospital shortly after she was discharged following brain surgery, a spokesman said on Monday.
But doctors said the two-time Oscar winner was listed in "good" condition and that no further complications were anticipated.

"The tests are not revealing anything and she seems to be healing well," said Ron Wise, spokesman for Cedars-Sinai Medical Centre. "Everything shows she's well on the mend, but doctors want to play this conservatively."
Taylor underwent four hours of surgery on Feb. 20 to remove an apparently benign tumour the size of a golf ball from the lining of her brain.

Last Thursday, one day after she was released from the hospital, Taylor celebrated her 65th birthday. She was readmitted on Saturday after suffering a minor seizure, which Wise said was common following neurosurgery.
